name: Magnetix Flux
details: Electric type damaging moves have a 50% chance to slow the target.

name: Frozen Heart
details: Ice type moves deal 50% more damage.

name: Prism Capacitor
details: The user's next Psychic type attack after taking damage from a special move deals 50% move damage.

name: Hot Streak
details: User is immune to fire type attacks, and receives a speed boost upon being hit by one.

name: Mint Condition
details: Gains attack and speed when hit by a grass type move, or when grassy terrain is set.

name: Withering Aura
details: User steals 1/8th of an attackers max HP when hit by a contact move.

name: Sand Bath
details: User is cured of status effects during sandstorms.

name: Encaptivate
details: Lowers opposing Special Attack on switch in.

name: Shadow Striker
details: Dark type moves have a 25% chance to flinch.

name: Thermal Bloom
details: In sun or snow, heal 10% max hp per turn. Ice moves in Sun and Fire moves in Snow deal 25% more damage.

name: Hall of Mirrors
details: Using Flash Cannon lowers the target's Special Defense. Does not overwrite Flash Cannon's base effect.

name: Frosty Winds
details: Wind moves are 50% stronger and 10% more accurate.

name: Crystalline
details: Rock type attacking moves used by this Pokemon are instead Steel type, and are 20% stronger.

name: Film Script
details: Attacking a Pokemon that is a Movie Star (Pikachu, Lucario, Zoroark, Landorus, Garchomp, Incineroar) does double damage, ignores immunities, and grants this Pokemon 1 stage of Attack, Special Attack, and Speed.

name: Shadow Pressue
details: Opposing pokemon lose twice as much PP when using a move. Flying and Psycihc type moves deal 50% more damage.

name: Shadow Guard
details: Damage dealt while at full health is halved. Flying and Psycihc type moves deal 50% more damage.

name: Brittle Crystal
details: Upon taking damage, lose one stage of Defense and gain two stages of Speed. Additionally, deal 1/8th max hp damage to attacker.

name: Shadow Boost
details: Super effective moves deal 25% more damage. Psychic moves deal 50% more damage. These effects stack multiplicitavely with each other.
